notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Steelfin Whale.
Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
